name: io.github.flow-steward/cognee
title: Cognee Memory
description: Store, recall and forget memories through your own Cognee MCP deployment. Run the upstream server with Streamable HTTP at /mcp and expose it through HTTPS; configure its databases and model providers before connecting.

instance_host.description: Host name of your HTTPS Cognee MCP deployment, without https:// or a path. The upstream HTTP server must run with --transport http --path /mcp and be exposed through TLS. This entry assumes no additional inbound authentication.
